proposals.before: Appraisal: In more than sixty years since Liao's founding, from Shendian through Huitong, the court knew no day of rest;
proposals.after: Appraisal: In more than sixty years since Liao's founding, from Shence through Huitong, the court knew no day of rest;
proposals.reason: 神冊 is the Shence era name; "Shendian" is a mistransliteration.

proposals.before: Appraisal: In over sixty years since Liao's rise, between the Shendian and Huitong reigns, there was no day with spare time;
proposals.after: Appraisal: In over sixty years since Liao's rise, between the Shence and Huitong reigns, there was no day with spare time;
proposals.reason: 神冊 corresponds to Shence, not Shendian.

proposals.before: In the second year of Qianheng, spring, first month, on bingzi day the new moon, the princes Longxu was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang and Longqing as Prince of Heng.
proposals.after: In the second year of Qianheng, spring, first month, on bingzi day the new moon, the imperial sons Longxu was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang and Longqing as Prince of Heng.
proposals.reason: Subject-verb disagreement: "the princes Longxu was" is ungrammatical; the Chinese 皇子 marks imperial sons.

proposals.before: On the fourth summer month the Emperor personally led a southern campaign.
proposals.after: In the fourth summer month the Emperor personally led a southern campaign.
proposals.reason: English date phrase requires "In" rather than "On" before a month.

decisions.reason: s0114 神冊 is the Liao era name Shence; idiomatic Shendian is a mistransliteration, and Shence restores the correct romanization without otherwise changing the sentence.
Literal likewise misreads 神冊 as Shendian; Shence matches the era name while leaving the rest of the wording intact.

decisions.after: In the second year of Qianheng, spring, first month, on bingzi day the new moon, the imperial son Longxu was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang and Longqing as Prince of Heng.
decisions.reason: 封皇子隆緒為梁王，隆慶為恒王 marks Longxu and Longqing as imperial sons, so princes is wrong; the proposed plural imperial sons still disagrees with was. Singular imperial son with the existing elliptical Longqing clause is grammatical and faithful.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 封皇子隆緒為梁王，隆慶為恒王

decisions.reason: 夏四月 is a month span, not a calendar day; English requires In before the month, so On the fourth summer month is ungrammatical and In the fourth summer month is the correct minimal repair.
